history.submitter_remarks: Chun Yip 駿業街 renamed to Wai Yip 偉業街 (G.N.1138); same centreline 12624. Not Tsun Yip Street 駿業街.

gazette_location.description_raw_en: With reference to Gazette Notification Nos. 929 and 1138 of 1960, it is hereby notified that the following street name has been discontinued with effect from Friday, 22nd July, 1960:— CHUN YIP STREET 駿業街
